parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.name as project_name, p.current_phase, p.updated_at, p.status, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - p.updated_at))/86400 as days_stale, c.name as client_name, c.email as client_email, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation_queue cq WHERE cq.project_id = p.id AND cq.status = 'pending') as pending_consultations, (SELECT MAX(ae.started_at) FROM agent_executions ae WHERE ae.project_id = p.id) as last_agent_run FROM projects p JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id WHERE p.status IN ('active', 'paused', 'blocked') AND p.current_phase NOT IN ('completed', 'archived') ORDER BY p.updated_at ASC
INSERT INTO activity_log (project_id, agent_name, action, phase_at_time, output_summary, status) VALUES (NULL, 'cron_project_review', 'review_sent', 'global', $1, 'success')
